description: Policy of scripts/native-deps-check.mjs: the product runs on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. A native or binary npm package family that reaches production must have a linux arm64 build; a gap anywhere else must be acknowledged here with a reason.

testOnly.reason: Test-only: it starts a throwaway PostgreSQL for the database test suites. It is declared in packages/db dependencies but only test-database.ts imports it, the production images are installed with --omit=dev --omit=optional (no server binary is shipped), and its linux arm64 build exists anyway.

acknowledged.reason: Optional dependency of rollup (web build tool, development only) that ships a linux x64 binary only; rollup falls back to its own implementation, so the ARM leg of CI builds the web without it and no production artefact carries it.

installScripts.reason: Each runs a script that selects the binary of the platform from its optional sibling packages; all of them have a linux arm64 sibling (checked above) and none is installed in a production image.
